where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/<YOUR_APP>/local/inputs.conf on the forwarder of the source that dropped
cloud_note: Same file on your own forwarders. Splunk-managed search and indexing tiers can't be edited.
sample: # Use only if the drop traces back to a stopped input@@[monitor:///var/log/<APP>/*.log]@@index = <INDEX>@@sourcetype = <SOURCETYPE>@@disabled = false
check_search: | tstats count where index=* earliest=-15m by index

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/<YOUR_APP>/local/inputs.conf on the forwarder that should write to this index
cloud_note: Same file on your own forwarders. Check that the index exists under Settings > Indexes.
check_search: | tstats count where index={{entity}} earliest=-60m by sourcetype, host

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/<YOUR_APP>/local/inputs.conf on {{entity}}, or in the deployment server app for it
cloud_note: Same file on your own forwarders.
check_search: | tstats count where index=* host={{entity}} earliest=-15m by sourcetype

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/splunk_httpinput/local/inputs.conf on the instance that receives HEC
cloud_note: Use Settings > Data inputs > HTTP Event Collector instead of this file. Never paste a real token into this app.
check_search: `exec_health_hec_metrics` earliest=-15m | `exec_health_hec_normalize` | stats sum(hec_events) AS events by token

cloud_note: Don't write outputs.conf by hand. Install the universal forwarder credentials app from your Cloud stack, which sets the destination and certificates.
check_search: index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=tcpin_connections hostname={{entity}} earliest=-15m | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen, sum(kb) AS kb by hostname, fwdType | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T")

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/<YOUR_APP>/local/outputs.conf on {{entity}}, only if the host was rebuilt
cloud_note: Don't write outputs.conf by hand. Install the universal forwarder credentials app from your Cloud stack, which sets the destination and certificates.
sample: # Restore power, network and splunkd first. This is only for a rebuilt host@@[tcpout]@@defaultGroup = primary_indexers@@@@[tcpout:primary_indexers]@@server = <INDEXER_1>:9997, <INDEXER_2>:9997@@useACK = true
check_search: index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=tcpin_connections hostname={{entity}} earliest=-15m | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen, sum(kb) AS kb by hostname, fwdType | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T")

cloud_note: On Splunk-managed instances, raise this with Splunk Support.
sample: No config change fits this problem. Fix the cause on the instance. Don't change health.conf to hide it.

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/<SEARCH_APP>/local/savedsearches.conf on the search head, after change control
cloud_note: Use Settings > Searches, reports, and alerts instead of this file.
check_search: index=_introspection sourcetype=splunk_resource_usage component=Hostwide host={{entity}} earliest=-60m | timechart span=5m avg(data.cpu_system_pct) AS system, avg(data.cpu_user_pct) AS user

cloud_note: Same files on your SC4S host. Point the URL at your Cloud stack's HEC endpoint.
check_search: | tstats count where index=* host={{entity}} earliest=-15m by index, sourcetype

cloud_note: Edge Processor and Ingest Processor pipelines are managed in their own Splunk UI.
sample: No config change fits this problem. Review the pipeline and its destination in the Edge Processor or Ingest Processor UI.
check_search: Open SC4S & Edge in this app and check queue fill and export errors for {{entity}}

where_it_goes: $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/splunk_exec_health/local/macros.conf, only if the macro hides your live indexes
cloud_note: Use Settings > Advanced search > Search macros instead of this file.
check_search: | tstats count where index=* earliest=-15m by index

cloud_note: Compare against your stack's license usage in the Cloud Monitoring Console.
sample: No config change fits this problem. Find the index or sourcetype that dropped, then use the sample for that source.
check_search: index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage earliest=-7d@d | timechart span=1d sum(b) AS bytes by idx

where_it_goes: the host named in the finding
cloud_note: The app does not edit the forwarder. Check splunkd on that host.
check_search: index=_internal host={{entity}} earliest=-60m | stats latest(_time) as last_seen

cloud_note: Same file on your own forwarders. Splunk-managed tiers cannot be edited.
check_search: | tstats count where index=* host={{entity}} earliest=-2h by _time span=1h

where_it_goes: the index named in the finding
cloud_note: The app does not edit indexes.conf.
check_search: | tstats count where index={{entity}} earliest=-8d by _time span=1h
